raw.title: v0.1.0
raw.body:
Initial public release of arazzo-cli — a standalone Arazzo 1.0 workflow executor and VS Code debugger.

## Highlights

- **Run workflows** — execute multi-step API sequences defined in YAML against live APIs
- **VS Code debugger** — set breakpoints in `.arazzo.yaml` files, step through workflows, inspect variables
- **Execution traces** — detailed `trace.v1` JSON artifacts with automatic sensitive value redaction
- **Deterministic replay** — re-execute traces offline with drift detection for CI regression testing
- **Parallel execution** — DAG-based scheduling runs independent steps concurrently
- **Generate workflows** — scaffold CRUD workflows from OpenAPI 3.x specs
- **Full expression language** — `$inputs`, `$steps`, `$response`, `$env`, XPath, JSON Pointer, interpolation
- **Control flow** — `onSuccess`/`onFailure` actions with goto, retry (with backoff), and end
- **Input validation** — type-check workflow inputs with strict mode
- **JSON output** — `--json` on every command for scripting and CI

## Platforms

- Linux x86_64
- macOS (Apple Silicon)
- Windows x86_64

## Stats

- 339 tests, all hermetic
- Zero unsafe code (`#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`)
- MIT licensed

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/strefethen/arazzo-cli/commits/v0.1.0
